painHook.title:
Anda mematikan penggera.
Anda tidak bangun.
painHook.copy: Satu ketukan separuh sedar mengorbankan sejam.

alarmCount.title: How many alarms do you set?

oneAlarmTrust.title: Would one alarm actually wake you?

insight.title: This isn’t a motivation problem.
insight.copy: When the alarm rings, your brain is still waking up. That’s why half-asleep taps win.

yes.title: Waking up isn’t the finish line.
yes.copy: One alarm gets you up — the first hour is where mornings are won. A mission before dismissal turns ‘up’ into ‘moving’.

sometimes.title: Motivation is a coin flip.
sometimes.copy: Some mornings you win, some the tap does. A mission takes the coin flip out of your morning.

goal.title: Apakah yang ingin anda ubah tentang pagi anda?

options.on_time: Tiba di kerja atau kelas tepat pada masanya

painPoints.title: Apakah yang biasanya mencuri pagi anda?

titlesByGoal.first_alarm: What stops you when the first alarm rings?
titlesByGoal.workouts: What gets between you and your morning workout?
titlesByGoal.no_rushing: What turns your morning into a rush?

options.snooze_unaware: Saya menekan tunda tanpa benar-benar ingat
options.up_not_moving: I’m awake, but I can’t get up

personalizedSolution.title: Each pattern, and what beats it.

solutions.snooze_unaware: The mission interrupts the snooze loop
solutions.dismiss_fall_asleep: The tap alone can’t end the wake-up
solutions.up_not_moving: The mission gets you moving before the alarm goes quiet

steps.title: Penggera berbunyi
steps.copy: Penggera berbunyi pada masa yang anda pilih.

steps.title: Lengkapkan misi anda
steps.copy: Lengkapkan misi foto langsung atau kuiz ringkas.

steps.title: Lengkapkan bangun
steps.copy: Lulus misi menandakan bangun telah selesai.

futureState.title: 06:30. Sudah bangun. Sudah bergerak.
futureState.copy: The first hour belongs to you.

mission.targetTitle: Which ones do you actually have?
mission.photoDisclosure: Foto diperiksa pada peranti anda. Foto galeri tidak dikira dan foto misi dipadam selepas pengesahan.

wakeTime.copy: Choose the time your first DawnVow should ring.

plan.title: DawnVow pertama anda sudah sedia.
